info.title: Megabull API Key API
info.description:
Public API documentation for endpoints that accept the `api-key` header.
You can generate an API key by going to `https://trade.megabull.in`, logging in, and under Profile you can generate an API key.
Keys expire after 1 month.

tags.name: Order
tags.description: Place, modify, list and cancel orders

put.description:
Modifies an existing pending order using the order ID in the path.
Use the `id` returned from GET /api/order/my, place order, or a previous modify response.
Do not send `id` in the request body.

**type**: `BUY` or `SELL`
**duration**: `MIS` (intraday) or `CNC` (delivery)
**orderType**: `LIMIT`, `MKT`, or `SL`
- `LIMIT` → provide `price`
- `MKT` → market order
- `SL` → provide `triggerPrice`

Use `instrumentToken` from GET /api/marketwatch/instruments.

parameters.name: orderId
parameters.description: Order ID from GET /api/order/my or from place/modify order response

put.description:
Cancels multiple orders by ID.
Each array item must be an order `id` received from GET /api/order/my, place order (POST /api/order/buysell), or modify order (PUT /api/order/buysell/{orderId}).
Each item in the response returns SUCCESS or FAILED with a message.

parameters.description: Room id these order ids belong to. Omit for the default personal workspace.

post.description: Creates a new public or private room. The creator automatically joins as owner.
Squares off open room positions/holdings, cancels pending room orders, and leaves.
Public rooms join directly. Private rooms require a valid invite code (the code from the invite email).
Room owner only. Emails a join code — sign-up link if the invited address has no MegaBull account yet, sign-in link otherwise.
The generic "Join by ID" entry point — accepts either a private room's invite code or a public room's share code, so the caller doesn't need to know the room id or which kind of code it is.
Joins the room referenced by a valid invite token.

get.description: Room configuration plus the caller's membership/wallet if they've joined.
Share code for a public room — enter it via "Join by ID".
Ranked list of active members by the room's configured winner metric.

Public, currently active rooms — dropdown source for joining a tournament. Sorted trending-first (most members, then most recently created). Supports an optional case-insensitive name search (`q`) plus paging (`page`, 0-based; `size`, default 20, max 100).

Rooms the authenticated user has joined (active and past), completed rooms sorted to the end. Supports an optional case-insensitive name search (`q`) plus paging (`page`, 0-based; `size`, default 20, max 100).

get.description:
Returns the public S3 URL for the instrument CSV with columns `tradingSymbol`, `instrumentName`, `instrumentToken`.
The file is refreshed whenever the API server starts.

Use the `instrumentToken` column as the token for GET /api/marketwatch/ltp/{instrumentToken} and POST/PUT /api/order/buysell.

Open `downloadUrl` in a browser to download the CSV.
Pass `redirect=true` to receive an HTTP 302 redirect to S3 instead (not supported in Swagger Try it out).

parameters.description: When true, responds with HTTP 302 redirect to S3 instead of JSON

get.description: Same shape as /my, for any user — for showing a badge on a profile or leaderboard row.
Current rating, level (1-50), badge tier, global leaderboard rank, progress to the next tier, and career room stats.
Rating change log, one entry per room settled, newest first — the source for a rating chart and upgrade/downgrade moments (`changeDirection`). Paged (`page`, 0-based; `size`, default 20, max 100).
Top 100 users ranked by rating, highest first — capped there regardless of paging. Paged (`page`, 0-based; `size`, default 20, max 100); a page entirely past rank 100 returns empty.

delete.description: Room owner only. Force-removes a joined member — squares off their open room positions/holdings and cancels their pending room orders first, same as if they'd left. The owner cannot remove themselves.
